summary: Changes tax_for so that it returns None for an unknown region instead of 0. Two shop callers still do arithmetic on its result, and nobody updated them.

findings.title: Callers crash on the new None return
findings.description: Now tax_for returns None for an unknown region. In pkgs/shop/src/shop/checkout.py line 6, order_total adds that result to amount_cents. A checkout for a region missing from RATES now raises TypeError instead of charging zero tax. That checkout fails for every customer in that region. Keep returning 0 for unknown regions. Otherwise, update order_total and tax_line to handle None explicitly.

findings.consequence: A checkout for a region missing from RATES now raises TypeError instead of charging zero tax. That checkout fails for every customer in that region.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for unknown regions. Otherwise, update order_total and tax_line to handle None explicitly.

findings.title: Receipt tax line breaks for unknown regions
findings.description: In pkgs/shop/src/shop/receipt.py line 6, tax_line divides the tax_for result by 100. When tax_for returns None, that division raises TypeError. Receipt rendering fails for any order whose region is missing from RATES. Make tax_line handle None, for example by printing zero tax or an explicit unknown-region message.

findings.fix: Make tax_line handle None, for example by printing zero tax or an explicit unknown-region message.

findings.title: No test covers the unknown-region branch
findings.description: The change adds a None return path to tax_for. No test in the repository exercises tax_for or its callers. Without a test, nothing caught the caller breakage. Future changes to this branch will also go unchecked. Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with a known region and an unknown region.
